description: Commission of Elections - Local Authorities Elections - 2018 : Exhibition of Electoral Registers
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically concerns the exhibition of electoral registers for the upcoming Local Authorities Elections in 2018. It details the process for public inspection of voter lists, procedures for reporting omissions or inclusions of unqualified electors, and is issued by the Election Commission. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and voter registration matters, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
